title: Platform standup notes — 2026-03-06
content:
Attendees: Aisha Patel (owner), Marco Ruiz, Janelle Kim, Derek O'Neal, Priya Singh, Omar (SRE), Tanya (serving-runtime)

Agenda:
- Quick wins / notes since last standup
- Control plane: rollout and health checks
- Routing: smart routing + fallback behavior
- Auth: token introspection and quota enforcement
- Quotas: spike handling and rate-limit tuning
- Blockers & action items

Notes / Updates:
1) Quick wins
- Autoscaler pruning bug patched and merged (PR linked). Reduced noisy scaling by ~8% on small workloads.
- Canary for control-plane v2.1 deployment started in eu-west-1; initial telemetry looks healthy (p95 latency +0.5ms).

2) Control plane
- Status: Canary is running ~50k requests/day. Health checks currently stable but we saw two transient auth-timeout errors during deploy window.
- Root cause hypothesis: token cache TTL mismatch between control plane and auth proxy. Marco is validating cache invalidation logic.
- Next: ramp to 10% traffic on 3/7 if no regressions.
- Note: Need a runbook entry for canary rollback triggers (priority: high). Derek to draft.

3) Routing
- Smart routing policy rollout is behind schedule due to additional compatibility checks for model variants.
- Current fallback behavior: when preferred model family is saturated, requests route to next-compatible quantized variant. Edge case: function calls with structured outputs dropped some tool hints. Janelle reproduced and created bug PLAT-4398.
- Temporary mitigation: for routes with function-calls enabled, pin routing to same model family until fix.

4) Auth
- Token introspection optimization: current flow validates introspection for every session start; we can cache results for 30s to reduce downstream load. Priya ran a load test showing 18% fewer auth RPCs.
- Blocker: KMS integration tests failing intermittently due to network timeouts in staging. Omar investigating network path to KMS endpoints.
- Action: Add defensive retry with jitter for KMS calls (Priya + Omar).

5) Quotas and rate limits
- Observed quota spikes from two internal test suites; these suites are being throttled by SRE temporarily.
- We need clearer per-route quota definitions: current global quota is too coarse for multi-tenant demos. Proposal: introduce per-customer per-route soft quotas with burst windows. Sketch doc in linked PR.
- Action: Tanya to prototype per-route quota config UI in console; target prototype by 3/13.

6) Incidents and alerts
- Alert PLAT-INC-2026-03-05: high auth latency tied to KMS timeouts. Mitigated by fallback credentials for critical endpoints; longer fix pending.
- Alert tuning: reduce noise from transient token-cache misses by increasing alert threshold to 15% over 5m for now.

Blockers / Risks:
- KMS flakiness blocks secure token issuance testing for private deployments.
- Routing fallback bug (PLAT-4398) can drop tool hints for function-calls — risk for customers using function/tool calling heavily.
- Canary rollback runbook missing (operational risk).

Action items (owners):
- Marco: confirm token cache TTL alignment and push fix to canary (due 2026-03-07).
- Derek: draft canary rollback runbook and post to Confluence (due 2026-03-08).
- Janelle: triage PLAT-4398 and prepare hotfix for routing compatibility (due 2026-03-10).
- Priya + Omar: implement KMS retry-with-jitter and add extra logging to staging (due 2026-03-09).
- Tanya: prototype per-route quota UI and share mockups (due 2026-03-13).
- SRE: keep throttling noisy internal test suites and confirm if any customer traffic affected (ongoing).

Notes / refs:
- Related tickets: PLAT-4321 (canary rollout plan), PLAT-4398 (routing fallback bug)
- PR: github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/276 (autoscaler pruning fix)
- Slack: #platform-routing thread with sample trace attached (see linked_artifacts)

Parking lot / follow-ups:
- Evaluate a short-lived token cache tier for high-throughput internal services.
- Discuss quota UI UX with product during 3/09 sync.

Quick wins for next week:
- Ship KMS retry fix to staging and re-run private deployment smoke tests.
- Merge routing compatibility patch for function-calls.
- Publish canary rollback runbook and run tabletop with on-call.

Minutes prepared by: Aisha Patel
